answer: Epoch-Lagged Consistency Gate: each agent’s actions form a behavioural thread scored per epoch by a vine copula over timing, task mix, and counterpart entropy. Influence at epoch t is its minimum consistency over prior k epochs against an umber-calibrated tolerance band; fresh or divergent identities stay near zero until they sustain the same thread. A sybil swarm must run many distinct yet internally consistent histories for k epochs, multiplying compute, coordination, and missed-opportunity costs with no early influence.
